title: Preparing a Saudi Embassy document enquiry
description: Ask about the document category and the permitted official route.
answer: A useful enquiry identifies the document, issuing country, intended use and receiving organisation. The mission or competent authority decides which official process applies.

sections.title: Identify the document precisely
sections.text: A degree, civil record, corporate document and power of attorney are not interchangeable categories. Use the exact title and identify the issuer.

sections.title: Ask about the applicable route
sections.text: Confirm current prerequisites, document format, any translation and whether personal appearance is required. Do not assume a representative can complete an applicant-only step.

sections.title: Separate private guidance from official work
sections.text: An independent adviser may help organise questions and preparation. It does not issue an embassy stamp, guarantee an appointment or determine the outcome.

sections.title: Before sharing originals
sections.text: Clarify who will receive the document, the official submission channel and the return arrangements. Avoid sending originals on the basis of a general promise.

sections.title: Fees and timing
sections.text: Ask for current official charges and a separate description of any private assistance fee. Do not treat an illustrative timeline as a promised completion date.

author: SK Attestation Services
